parameters.description: Decimal control-plane record ID returned by openflare_node_list

parameters.description: Number of records per page

parameters.description: Filter by node type. Omit for all types.

Update exactly one parameter of an existing policy and preserve all others. Use openflare_performance_list to identify the policy, affected nodes, and valid values. Editing the default policy affects every unassigned OpenFlare Edge node. The result confirms controller storage, not node application.

parameters.name: policy_id
parameters.description: Performance policy record ID from openflare_performance_list

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Exact parameter key from openflare_performance_list, not a display label.

parameters.name: value

parameters.name: domain_record_id
parameters.description: Hostname record ID from openflare_domain_list

parameters.name: domain_record_ids
parameters.description: Unbound domain record IDs from openflare_domain_list. Use decimal strings, not hostnames.

parameters.name: enable_https

parameters.description: Optional upstream Host override. If omitted, use normal edge Host handling.

parameters.name: site_name
parameters.description: Unique display name for the new site.

parameters.name: upstreams
parameters.description: Ordered direct HTTP(S) URLs including scheme and optional port. No credentials, query strings or fragments. Multiple upstreams must share a scheme and have no path prefix.
